opening.argument: The video is presented as an electronic music upload within a channel for sharing free music. Its title identifies a track edit, “Dikanda - Ederlezi (Azamat Edit),” while the description explicitly offers a “Free Download Music Channel” and explains, “Last two years i'm collecting best free download music “my taste” and i want to share with you..” The accompanying request, “Please: SUPPORT artist, Record Companies for those music GIFTS !!,” is a general appeal to support the creators and rights holders of the music. The crowd gathered beside a lit lake is consistent with music or event imagery. Although the audio says, “The time for you to go to Oracles is now,” it does not connect that phrase to money, credentials, participation, or any promised benefit.
